authorityPolicy.prohibitedPromotion: Do not describe these single-replay relationships as canonical Deadlock mechanics until independent replay replication.
withdrawn: 45m as an exact or approximate validated ground-soul vacuum threshold
m_hVacuumTarget as last-hit or sole economic-recipient authority

operationalClaims.claim: Matched AssignedGold episodes can be exhaustively classified into targeted immediate, targeted early-floor, targeted stable-floor, targetless match-time-scaled timeout-candidate, and censored targetless lifecycle classes.
m_hVacuumTarget represents physical vacuum targeting and is not the exclusive economic-recipient authority.
The credited last-hitter is strongly associated with the AssignedGold economic recipient set and is consistently included in the validated exact-partition cohort.
Economic-sharing membership is best explained in the validated cohort by death-time 3D distance from the Trooper, with an empirical ~2150 HU envelope.
operationalClaims.caution: 2150 HU is an empirical single-replay boundary and is not promoted to an exact canonical engine constant.

operationalClaims.claim: Observed AssignedGold team reward is distributed as an exact integer partition among recipients, with strong credited-last-hitter remainder priority.
Targetless lifecycle termination has strong exact-tick negative-control support for no AssignedGold payout.
operationalClaims.caution: Use targetless lifecycle termination / timeout candidate rather than claiming canonical expiration semantics.

operationalClaims.claim: Angle component 1 behaves as yaw for body, eye, and camera orientation, using PLUS_YAW_0 world convention: 0°=+X, 90°=+Y, 180°=-X, 270°=-Y.
m_angEyeAngles component 1 is operational shot/aim yaw and component 0 is pitch with negative Cartesian pitch sign.
m_angClientCamera is a distinct third-person camera-orientation signal and should not replace m_angEyeAngles for aim-relative behavioral features.
CBodyComponent.m_angRotation component 1 is a movement-aligned body-facing yaw proxy.
operationalClaims.caution: Exact animation/model-facing semantics remain narrower than the operational body-yaw proxy.

deferredToCrossReplay.question: Does the ~732-735 HU operational ground-soul vacuum envelope reproduce independently, and what is the true engine boundary?
deferredToCrossReplay.reason: Operational opportunity labeling is already adequate in test.dem.

deferredToCrossReplay.question: Does the ~2150 HU / 54.6 m death-time 3D recipient-set boundary reproduce across independent matches?
When multiple allies satisfy physical-vacuum proximity, what determines final m_hVacuumTarget?
Does the ~18 s -> +4 s/min -> ~40 s targetless lifecycle function reproduce across independent matches and game versions?
Do match-time scaling, variant modifiers, comeback behavior, sharing schedule, and integer allocation reproduce independently?
Do provisional Trooper variant multipliers and Super behavior reproduce across varied independent matches?
Does m_angEyeAngles preserve the same yaw/pitch and shot-direction relationship across players, heroes, matches, and versions?

closedForSingleReplay: Exact 732 versus 735 HU ground-soul vacuum threshold tuning.
Additional AssignedGold reward residual fitting to eliminate remaining +/-1-3 soul errors.
More movement-only validation of yaw convention.
Attempts to force m_hVacuumTarget to equal economic ownership.

replicationContract.compare: threshold curves rather than one fixed hardcoded radius

Test whether death-time Trooper-centered 3D geometry continues to predict the recipient set.

Verify component-1 yaw, component-0 eye pitch, pitch sign, and eye-angle alignment to successful shot direction.

resourceEvents.production: Distinguish Trooper death, player-last-hit credit, AssignedGold production, physical availability, vacuum targeting, economic recipient membership, payout, and targetless termination.
resourceEvents.opportunity: Physical floor-persistent AssignedGold can constitute a resource-access opportunity independently of who is economically assigned the reward.
resourceEvents.physicalCollector: m_hVacuumTarget is a physical-vacuum target candidate and must not be substituted for economic recipient identity.
resourceEvents.economy: Use validated AssignedGold recipient-set and allocation semantics when constructing resource-value consequences.
